title: README console quick start downloads a release asset that returns 404
description: README links releases/latest/download/kanbus-console-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz, which is 404. The asset is now kbsc-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz. Also the release tag is named kanbus-py-0.34.0 although it carries the Rust binaries.
